subject: POC access & success criteria - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC recap & next steps (access + success criteria)

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the call earlier - great to meet you and the Acme team. Per our discussion, I wanted to recap the proposed POC scope, success criteria, access requirements, and next steps so we can lock the kickoff timeline.

POC objective (2-week trial):
- Validate Redwood inference for Acme's internal summarization workflow (5-30k tokens/day).
- Measure latency at target QPS and compare cost/quality vs current provider.

Success criteria (examples):
- Average 95th percentile latency < 250ms for staged workload (50 concurrent sessions).
- Summary F1 >= 0.78 vs your internal eval set (we'll run initial eval).
- Token cost <= $0.015/token equivalent on the workload profile.

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Acme: provide a small eval set (10-20 representative documents) and test harness. (Alice / Bob)
- Redwood: provision a staging org, ingest model variants, provide API access and telemetry dashboard. (Marissa / Dev)
- Security review: exchange SOC2 and network allowlist details. (Alice / security@acme.com)

Timeline (proposed):
- Mar 16 - kickoff + access provisioned (staging org + API key + SSO invites)
- Mar 17-25 - run tests and iterate (1 week active testing)
- Mar 26 - results review + next steps

Access & provisioning items we need from Acme to start:
1) SSO: please confirm SAML domain and the admin user who can accept IdP connection (we will send invites to the admin).
2) IP allowlist: provide static egress IP(s) or CIDR(s) to add to our firewall (we'll provide example CIDR below).
3) Test account(s): list of users who should receive staging access (email addresses).
4) POC contact and billing contact for contract/credits (name + email).

Redwood-side access we'll provide:
- Staging org + a scoped API key (scoped to the POC)
- Read-only telemetry dashboard + per-route token breakdown
- Short onboarding checklist (attached)

Attachments:
- ACME_POC_Success_Criteria.docx (proposed success criteria template)
- redwood_poc_onboarding_checklist.pdf (onboarding steps & what we need)

Example IP allowlist entry we can accept: 198.51.100.24/32 (single static IP) or 198.51.100.0/24 if you have a block.

Questions I have for you today:
- Can you confirm who will accept the SSO invite and the admin email?
- Do you have static egress IPs or do we need to accept a VPN/JIT approach?
- Is the 2-week window starting Mar 16 workable for your team?

If that all looks good I'll provision the staging org and aim to send the API key and SSO invites by EOD Mar 15 so you can onboard on the 16th.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap - this matches my notes. We're aligned on the goals and the proposed timeline looks fine. A few items from our side:

1) SSO admin: Bob Lee (bob.lee@acme.com) will accept the SAML connection. Our IdP is hosted at acme.okta.com (SAML).
2) IP allowlist: we can provide a single egress IP per environment. I'll confirm the exact CIDR by tomorrow but expect to be a single /32.
3) Test users: I'll share a short list of three staging users by EOD today.
4) Security artifacts: security@acme.com will need SOC2 Type II and information on data residency/retention. Can you share a link to those?
5) API keys: are keys per-org or per-user for POC? We prefer a scoped service key for the POC so we can control rotation.

Kickoff: Mar 16 works for us as long as credentials and SSO are ready.

Thanks - I'll loop Bob on network details shortly.

Best,
Alice
Alice Johnson
Head of Data Platforms, Acme Corp

SSO: we support SAML (Okta, Azure AD). I will send a SAML invite to bob.lee@acme.com from our admin console - Bob should accept and we'll complete the metadata exchange.

API keys: for the POC we will create one scoped "service" API key tied to a staging org. That key can be rotated; we'll provide rotation instructions. If you want per-user keys later we can expand.

Security docs: here are the links - SOC2 report (redacted) and our security overview: - https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-redacted - https://redwood.ai/security/overview

IP allowlist: example entries we can add: 198.51.100.24/32 (single egress IP) or 198.51.100.0/24. If you don't have static IPs we can enable a temporary VPN/JIT workflow and provide a checklist for network team.

Next steps (action owners):
- Acme (Alice/Bob): provide final egress IP(s) and list of staging users (by EOD Mar 13).
- Redwood (Marissa/Dev): provision staging org, create scoped API key, send SSO invite to Bob (by EOD Mar 15).
- Security (Acme): security@acme.com to review SOC2 link and confirm any additional artifact needs.

I've attached the onboarding checklist again and the success criteria template - I'll start provisioning now and will follow up with the API key once ready.
